review: EN/HI written 13 Oct 2026, shown to the founder in the Group A screenshots

lines.text: Chapter and Book helps you remember the key ideas of a chapter — and how they fit together.
First, paste or upload the chapter. The app suggests its five to nine key ideas and a simple mind map.
Check them. Change any idea to your own words, and keep the ideas in the order of the chapter.
Then place the ideas in your memory palace — one idea at each station, in order.
At each station, make one vivid picture that joins the place and the idea.
A whole book works the same way: the book is a building, and each chapter is a room in it.
Now walk the chapter: go through your palace and say each idea. Then answer five questions.
Ideas you miss come back in your review. Let's start with a chapter you are studying now.
